title: Ashbury Rewards Rate Plan Earning Notes: Elite Bonus Base on Negotiated, Group and Package Rates
content:
For the Ashbury Rewards elite bonus of a stay booked under three rate plans, the elite bonus base — the base points the elite bonus percentage is applied to — depends on the rate plan of the stay, read from the stay's Room Reservations record.

## Note by rate plan

- **Corporate Negotiated Rate and Group Block Rate.** A stay booked under the Corporate Negotiated Rate or the Group Block Rate takes as elite bonus base the base points its room nights earned, which are its nightly rate times its nights times the base points per US dollar of the hotel's brand, rounded down to a whole point and never more than its posted base points.
- **Bed & Breakfast Package Rate.** A stay booked under the Bed & Breakfast Package Rate takes as elite bonus base its posted base points less the base points of the plan's package supplement, which are the package supplement per night times its nights times the base points per US dollar of the brand, rounded down to a whole point.
- **Other rate plans.** The other rate plans carry no different elite bonus base under this note.

The base points per US dollar are five at Ashbury Express and Ashbury Inn & Suites hotels and ten at the other brands. The nights are the nights shown on the stay's Room Reservations record; the nightly rate is its room rate per night before tax; the package supplement per night is the figure of the Bed & Breakfast Package Rate plan. The posted base points are the base points transactions naming the stay.

## Worked figures (hypothetical stays)

| Rate plan | Brand | Nightly rate | Nights | Posted base points | Elite bonus base |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Corporate Negotiated Rate | Ashbury Grand | 189.00 USD | 3 | 6100 | 189.00 times 3 times 10 is 5670; 5670 |
| Group Block Rate | Ashbury Hotel | 210.00 USD | 3 | 5400 | 6300 exceeds the posted base points; 5400 |
| Bed & Breakfast Package Rate, supplement taken as 35.00 USD | Ashbury Express | — | 2 | 1550 | 35.00 times 2 times 5 is 350; 1550 less 350 is 1200 |
